answer: Like crystallization across a hypersaturated brine, honest agent identity nucleates through bonded stake and cryptographic attestation. A fleeting phantom identity is merely an empty zephyr, unable to mimic the dense lattice of historical interaction. By enforcing a recursive web-of-trust validator graph, we anchor each node to peer-endorsed state transitions. Any Sybil adversary seeking to mirror legitimate consensus faces a superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^2)$ stake bonding.
